description:
Set or turn off your low-balance alert and your two spending caps. A limit you leave out is not changed.
Use for: capping what your wallet pays per bounty or per 24 hours, and choosing when you get a low-balance email. Moves no money.
Not for: reading your limits and balance (get_wallet); adding money to your wallet (fund_wallet).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: set_wallet_controls({"spendingCapPer24h":{"amount":50000,"currency":"usd"},"lowBalanceAlertAt":null})
Repeat: A repeat with the same input, and the same key if you sent one, does not act twice: it returns the same result, finishes the first call, or is refused.
Errors: account_setup_required; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

lowBalanceAlertAt.description: You get an email when your balance falls below this. From 0 to $100,000. Null turns it off. Left out: not changed.

spendingCapPer24h.description: The most your wallet pays in any 24 hours. From 0 to $100,000. Null turns it off. Left out: not changed.

spendingCapPerBounty.description: The most your wallet funds for one bounty’s hires and prepaid spots; excludes tips and reimbursements. From 0 to $100,000. Null turns it off. Left out: not changed.
